reviews.title: URGENT: DEADLOCK LETTER ISSUED, 75+ EMAILS IGNORED & VULNERABLE CARER DISCONNECTED MONTHLY (Ref: CAS-2769234-C8K4D2 / Order ID: G0041102869)
reviews.body:
Over 8 months have passed with 75+ emails ignored. Lebara continues to send generic automated replies, ignore binding written agreements, permit customer service staff to act with extreme hostility, and cut off my phone service every month.   Lebara issued a formal "Final Position / Deadlock Letter" on 15/10/26 attempting to close the complaint and refusing further support. Following further emails on 16/10/26, Lebara has offered zero resolution. Cutting my service directly endangers a vulnerable carer who relies on uninterrupted calls for critically ill parents.   Chronology of Breaches & Hostility
Mar 2026: Purchased 50GB Uswitch plan (£3.18/mo). Lebara failed to port number (07766 137835), sent wrong SIM hardware, mis-sold a pricier plan, and 3 agents (Moin, Rulin, Zeeshaw) hung up. Complaint ignored for a month.   
Jun 2026: Service cut off without notice. Lebara agreed in writing on 12/06/26 to provide a free 6-month 50GB plan.   
Jul 2026: Service cut off again. Agent Akshay threatened to remove credit unless I deleted factual Trustpilot reviews. My reviews vanished. On 14/07/26, Karan Chauhan formally confirmed in writing: "As discussed, we will proceed with activating a 50GB plan at no cost for a period of six months... active until January 2027. To ensure there is no interruption to your service, we will manually activate the plan each month one day prior to your plan renewal date."   
Aug 2026: Service cut off on 11/08/26. Agent Urvi demanded payment and hung up. Agent Rosita refused reactivation and hung up.   
Sep & Oct 2026: Service cut off repeatedly. Agents Harshal, Darshan, and Shriraj demanded unauthorized payments, acted rudely, reneged on written promises, and hung up on a vulnerable carer.   15th Oct 2026 (Deadlock Letter): Lebara issued a Deadlock Letter closing the complaint despite written contracts.   TODAY: Contract cancelled yet again. Agent Shriraj acted rudely, ignored my vulnerable carer status, and hung up on me. I called back and spoke to Agent Faizan, who refused reactivation until I cited Karan Chauhan's 14/07/26 email confirmation. Faizan reconnected the line.  
 Standard Generic Brush-Offs
Business Operations Director John-Paul Patten has posted the exact same canned response on my reviews 8 times: "Thanks for taking the time... a member of my team will reach out ASAP." This public post is deceitful—no one follows up and the monthly cut-offs continue.   Lebara is in breach of the UK Consumer Rights Act and Ofcom General Conditions on Vulnerability.   
ACTION REQUIRED: Senior management must honor the written 6-month resolution terms through January 2027 without monthly disconnections, retract the deadlock stance, stop agents hanging up on vulnerable customers, and pay compensation for over 8 months of distress and wasted time. Evidence (75+ emails, call logs, Deadlock Letter) is escalated directly to Ofcom and the Communications Ombudsman.

reviews.title: Ported number dead for 7 days / Case CAS-3025018-L9Q4W3
reviews.body:
There’s so many steps and failures it is hard to know how much to share. My wife’s 15-year personal number was successfully ported to Lebara on November 2 (confirmed by an email), but on Nov 3 the line has was completely dead with a persistent PDP authentication failure and has been ever since, which they confirmed with an email saying it was an esim activation failure on their end and they would work on it. I’ve had the same empty promise on multiple chats online with agents. Everyone says 24-48 hours, that passes, nothing is fixed or updated. I’d also add that the agents were rude in the live chats sometimes using all caps and then ending the chat immediately after a “are you still there?” auto reply. They repeatedly say it is a priority or they will help make sure personally it happens. They don’t. Time passes. Nothing happens. We can’t get a PAC code to even leave with the number because they want to text to the number that they haven’t fixed and activated.
I even tried emailing the CEO’s email knowing that executive teams can often escalate something that the front line can’t. Even in this case there has been zero reply. After attempting contact via their care email I’m now leaving this negative review. It has been a horribly stressful experience, cataloged by their case number that does not appear to do anything. I am absolutely ready to report this to the ombudsman as I’ve had conflicting, rude, and completely unhelpful responses combined with a complete lack of response from other contacts. My wife needs the number back quickly and a response from someone, not a generic auto reply or scripted CSR.

reviews.title: At the beginning of October I received…
reviews.body:
At the beginning of October I received an email from Lebara stating they had been unable to collect my monthly fee and stated that I must log into my account to correct this.

I got in touch with my bank and they had heard nothing from Lebara.

I logged into my account on four separate occasions over the next couple of weeks and on each occasions was unable to complete any effort to set up a new payment as their system was not functioning.

There has been no reason whatsoever for the payment not to have been made by my bank and it had been made for the previous three years.

I have now received a fresh email from Lebara to state that my account has been transferred to pay as you go with hugeley increaeed costs.

Clearly an intentional process on the part of Lebara all along.

Lebara are not a trustworthy organisation and I would advise avoiding them at all costs.
